summary: The ADVISOR paper does not provide any link to the authors' own code repository, and no GitHub repository matching the ADVISOR tool was found despite extensive searching across repo names, code content, and web sources. The paper's GitHub repo search budget (12) and code search budget (4) were fully exhausted. The paper's experimental evaluation uses S2CBench benchmarks (DARClab-UTD/S2CBench, in known_repos.json) and the EvoApproxLib approximate arithmetic library (ehw-fit/evoapproxlib), both reported as third-party. The ADVISOR methodology itself involves commercial EDA tools (NEC CyberWorkBench for HLS, proprietary logic synthesis) and is not released as open-source.
